changes.summary: Rejected symlinked, empty, over-16 MiB, and corrupt image inputs before loading the TRELLIS.2 pipeline.
Exposed the pinned nvdiffrast dependency's non-commercial research and evaluation restriction on the recipe card.
Validated embedded UV, base-color, and metallic-roughness PBR data on a bounded triangle mesh before atomic GLB publication.
Loaded FlexGEMM's shipped autotune cache read-only and disabled runtime cache writes for UID 10001.
Declared exact one-image input and single-GLB output slots with bounded bytes.
Replaced the metadata-only checkpoint binding with a real pinned TRELLIS.2 image-to-GLB execution path.
Added the exact companion sparse decoder, public DINOv3 encoder snapshot, native CuMesh, FlexGEMM, nvdiffrast, o-voxel, and ARM64 SDPA compatibility closure.
Kept Candidate status until the reproducible offline build and workload pass a physical DGX Spark canary.
Marked the binding non-executable pending TRELLIS.2 source, its companion decoder, native extensions, and a GLB adapter.
Added the authoritative isolated image input contract.
Corrected the checkpoint license to MIT.
Initial reviewed catalog release of TRELLIS.2 4B pytorch-pipeline single Spark.
Recovered the first public legacy revision from before semantic release tracking.
